def stress(t, e, g, taus, amps):
    left = t[:, None] - t[:-1]
    right = t[:, None] - t[1:]
    past = right >= 0
    rate = np.diff(e) / np.diff(t)
    out = g * e.copy()
    for (tau, a) in zip(taus, amps):
        out += a * tau * ((np.exp(-np.maximum(right, 0) / tau) - np.exp(-np.maximum(left, 0) / tau)) * past) @ rate
    return out
